I created `/vercel/sandbox/middleware.ts` that logs every incoming request to the console. It uses Next.js middleware, which runs on every request before it reaches your routes.

Each log line prints the HTTP method and pathname, e.g.:

```
[GET] /

```

The middleware calls `NextResponse.next()` to pass the request through unchanged — it only observes, it doesn't modify anything.
